answer: Mechanism: Pigment Entropy Quota. Each identity consumes one single-use flake from a batch-limited pigment harvested on an island mesa. A public ledger precommits each flake’s random spectral/isotope fingerprint and batch quota. Registration submits the fingerprint; the ledger marks it spent and permits one active agent. Sybils require obtaining, assaying, and consuming many distinct flakes, exhausting scarce pigment supply and exposing logistics, while replays fail—costing physical procurement and assay labor, not capital.
